verdict.rationale: LightSprint claims it can turn Figma designs into working frontend code, and its planning flow lets teams pick mockups before handing off one implementation task. Both suggest visual design input can drive agent implementation. However, nothing shows a user attaching their own screenshot or annotated image to a task. Agent-captured screenshots are review output, not input, so they are not credited. Missing for 10: documented attachment of screenshots or images to tasks, support for marked-up or annotated inputs, details of how the agent interprets visual references, and independent or hands-on corroboration.

support.subject: As a developer, I can attach a marked-up screenshot or mockup to a task so the agent implements the correct visual change

citations.quote: Turn Figma designs into working frontend code
Pick options and mockups before anything is built, then hand the plan off as one implementation task.
